sentences.text: This application is dismissed as withdrawn.
The petitioner is given liberty to raise all the grounds at the stage of framing of charge.
3. The Trial Court is directed to proceed with the trial.

4. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the District Judge, Gaya for its compliance through FAX and e-mail forthwith.
Ref:- Cr. Misc No. 19887 of 2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and State.
2.

This application has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Kurtha P.S. Case No. 289 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 337, 379, 504, 354, 354B, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the D.P. Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he is innocent and he has not committed any offence as it has been alleged in the F.I.R.
He further submits that petitioner has never demanded any dowry neither from the opposite party no. 2 nor from her family members.
He further submits that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
4. Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer of the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40712 of 2019(5) dt.17-08-2023 5.
In view of law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in case of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273, the application for anticipatory bail is allowed.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. Accordingly, let petitioner, above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks from today, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M, Arwal (Jehanabad)
in connection with Kurtha P.S. Case No. 289 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.PC and he will also regularly pay maintenance amount which has been decided earlier.
(Sandeep Kumar, J)

Harsh/
